question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.
sql:
-- Build the full calculation step by step
WITH customer_first AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date) as first_payment
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) as total_ltv
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_first_7 AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id, SUM(p.amount) as first_7_days_sales
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_first cf ON p.customer_id = cf.customer_id
    WHERE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cf.first_payment)) / 3600 < 7 * 24
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
),
customer_first_30 AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id, SUM(p.amount) as first_30_days_sales
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_first cf ON p.customer_id = cf.customer_id
    WHERE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cf.first_payment)) / 3600 < 30 * 24
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
),
per_customer AS (
    SELECT 
        cf.customer_id,
        cf.first_payment,
        cl.total_ltv,
        COALESCE(c7.first_7_days_sales, 0) as first_7_sales,
        COALESCE(c30.first_30_days_sales, 0) as first_30_sales,
        CASE WHEN cl.total_ltv > 0 
            THEN COALESCE(c7.first_7_days_sales, 0) / cl.total_ltv * 100.0 
            ELSE 0 
        END as pct_7_days,
        CASE WHEN cl.total_ltv > 0 
            THEN COALESCE(c30.first_30_days_sales, 0) / cl.total_ltv * 100.0 
            ELSE 0 
        END as pct_30_days
    FROM customer_first cf
    JOIN customer_ltv cl ON cf.customer_id = cl.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN customer_first_7 c7 ON cf.customer_id = c7.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN customer_first_30 c30 ON cf.customer_id = c30.customer_id
    WHERE cl.total_ltv > 0
)
SELECT 
    AVG(pct_7_days) as avg_pct_7_days,
    AVG(pct_30_days) as avg_pct_30_days,
    AVG(total_ltv) as avg_total_ltv
FROM per_customer
